explanation: Merges main into the rhythm-scan change. From main: survey view and card tests cover GenePageSurvey, the source tiles and familyTeaser; symbolRenames.test.ts and queryIndex.test.ts cover reading a renamed gene across studies, pickStoredMember, compareCell and the Compare downloads. From this branch: lombScargleFloor.test.ts pins the floor formula, its preconditions, a cap-breaking gappy pattern, the large-time-origin counterexample and a 200-design property (in the focused validation suite, 136 tests); rhythmCall.test.ts is the call and verdict decision table; the notes and results-table tests take lsFloor objects and a q: null row.
